key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply with miners and banks leading declines amid $100 oil and Trump oil-price warning
RBA policy pivot toward recession: business conditions weakest since pandemic, rate-cut expectations intensify
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Australia softens gas supply rules; Labor pursues gas reservation over tax, easing Asian supply fears
AUD shocker looms as oil-driven inflation and Chinese inflation surge weigh on the dollar
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
WA gold exploration surge: Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania all advancing projects
China adds 650,000 oz gold in biggest monthly buy since 2023, supporting gold prices
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment remains resilient
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars

sectors.trend: Sharp decline. Iron ore weakness spreads across the complex, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX. However, gold and copper sub-sectors show relative strength: China's record gold buying, WA gold exploration boom (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania), and Flagship's copper expansion provide pockets of resilience.
sectors.implications: Iron ore exposure remains a drag; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and copper (STO.AX, FMG.AX copper division). WA juniors (GWP.AX, AUC.AX) offer speculative upside but carry execution risk.

sectors.trend: Banks sharply lower as ASX slumps. RBA 'chooses recession' narrative raises credit-loss concerns. Bathla's collapse ripples through private credit, raising systemic risk. NSW stamp duty hit threatens REIT and property-linked lending.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression and elevated NPL risk. Private credit exposure (Bathla) warrants caution. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by stamp duty and high-end property weakness.

sectors.trend: Oil near $100/bbl on Iran conflict and Trump oil-price warning. Australia softens gas supply rules and pursues gas reservation, supporting domestic gas producers. US nat-gas abundant, pressuring global gas. Power giant seeks AI data centres at coal plants.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from $100 oil and gas reservation policy. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (AGL.AX, CGP.AX) is a medium-term structural theme but faces energy-transition backlash.

sectors.trend: Medicare review flags women and complex-care patients losing out, signalling potential policy reform. CSL.AX remains a defensive anchor but faces global biotech sentiment (Infleqtion, Peloton downgrades).
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SXH.AX offer defensive quality. Medicare reform could create opportunities in aged-care and women's health providers.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. Property chiefs call for more migrants to build housing. NSW stamp duty hit threatens budget. Migrant sham contracting raises labour-cost concerns.
sectors.implications: REITs under pressure. Builders (WBC.AX construction, WES.AX) may benefit from housing supply push. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) offer relative safety.

sectors.trend: AI data centres at coal plants signal infrastructure demand. Austal jumps on $1.9b bid. ServiceNow +33% globally. Apple scraps MacBook models. AI traffic lights in Brisbane.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech remains thin; global AI capex cycle benefits infrastructure and power names. Austal (AUS.AX) M&A activity signals consolidation.

key_themes: Oil at $100/bbl from Iran conflict drives inflation risk and RBA policy dilemma
RBA pivots toward recession; rate cuts likely but credit risk rising
Iron ore structural weakness vs. gold/copper strength
Gas policy shift: reservation over tax, softened supply rules
Private credit stress (Bathla) as emerging systemic risk
Housing bifurcation: high-end correction, affordable resilience
Chinese inflation surge and record gold buying
WA gold exploration super-cycle in junior miners
AI data centre demand straining energy transition

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation and RBA policy misstep
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); monitor RBA statement for rate-cut timing; maintain cash buffer

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand slowdown and China inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX weight; rotate to gold and copper exposure; monitor Chinese PMI and inflation data
Review bank balance-sheet exposure to private credit; avoid leveraged credit funds; monitor ASX-listed lenders
Hedge USD-denominated liabilities; favour export-oriented miners with natural AUD hedge; monitor AUD/USD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction in high-end segment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT exposure; favour affordable-housing and construction plays; monitor NSW stamp duty policy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran conflict escalation and supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy sector overweight; monitor geopolitical developments; keep portfolio liquid

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy: domestic gas and oil producers
opportunities.rationale: $100 oil, gas reservation policy, and softened supply rules create multi-quarter tailwind for WDS, WLE, SXG

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore to gold and copper
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weakness vs. China's record gold buying and copper strength; WA gold juniors in exploration super-cycle

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: RBA recession pivot and business conditions at pandemic lows favour defensive quality; Medicare reform tailwind
$1.9b bid signals consolidation in shipbuilding; potential upside if deal completes

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreads; banks face credit risk from RBA recession pivot and Bathla contagion

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and high-end property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; NSW stamp duty hit; housing market bifurcation risk
AUD shocker risk, oil volatility, and private credit contagion warrant liquidity buffer

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. $100 oil and Iran conflict create inflation volatility; RBA rate-cut expectations provide partial support but credit-risk fears (Bathla, recession) cap upside. Miners and banks remain the drag. Gold and energy are relative outperformers. Expect 3-5% downside risk on ^AXJO before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA eases and oil normalises below $90. Gold/copper structural demand supports materials rotation. Gas reservation and energy infrastructure (AI data centres) create multi-year themes. Housing bifurcation continues. Key risk: prolonged Iran conflict or Chinese demand collapse.
